process.title: 实现 dijkstra.py 有向图最短路径与 tests/test_dijkstra.py
process.scope: Owns only dijkstra.py and tests/test_dijkstra.py. Does not touch nthprime, windscale, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
process.task:
Create dijkstra.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's Dijkstra spec, plus tests/test_dijkstra.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- Graph is a dict: keys are node names (str), values are adjacency dicts (neighbor name -> weight). Edges are directed as given; nodes appearing only as neighbors (not as keys) have no outgoing edges. Weights must be int/float (bool rejected); non-numeric raises TypeError; negative weight raises ValueError; non-dict graph, non-dict adjacency, or non-str node name raises TypeError.
- dijkstra(graph, source) -> tuple[dict, dict]: returns (dist, prev). dist contains every node in the graph (appearing as key or as neighbor): reachable nodes hold the shortest distance (source is 0), unreachable nodes hold math.inf. prev contains only the mapping of reachable non-source nodes to their predecessor (source and unreachable nodes are not in prev). source not in graph raises ValueError.
- shortest_path(graph, source, target) -> list: returns the shortest path node list from source to target (both ends included); unreachable returns []; source == target returns [source]; source or target not in graph raises ValueError.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- Graph G1 = {"A": {"B": 1, "C": 4}, "B": {"C": 2, "D": 5}, "C": {"D": 1}, "D": {}, "E": {}}: dijkstra(G1, "A") dist is A=0, B=1, C=3, D=4, E=math.inf; prev == {"B": "A", "C": "B", "D": "C"}; shortest_path(G1, "A", "D") == ["A", "B", "C", "D"]; shortest_path(G1, "A", "C") == ["A", "B", "C"]; shortest_path(G1, "A", "E") == []; shortest_path(G1, "A", "A") == ["A"]; shortest_path(G1, "D", "A") == [] (directed, not reversible).
- Graph G2 = {"S": {"T": 2.5, "U": 1.5}, "U": {"T": 0.5}, "T": {}}: dist["T"] == 2.0, dist["U"] == 1.5, prev == {"U": "S", "T": "U"}, shortest_path(G2, "S", "T") == ["S", "U", "T"].
- Graph G3 = {"A": {"B": 7}}: dist["B"] == 7, prev == {"B": "A"}.
- dijkstra({"A": {"B": -1}}, "A"), dijkstra(G1, "Z"), shortest_path(G1, "A", "Z") raise ValueError.
- dijkstra([("A", {})], "A"), dijkstra({"A": {"B": "x"}}, "A"), dijkstra({"A": {"B": True}}, "A") raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only dijkstra.py and tests/test_dijkstra.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.
